description: Missouri Secretary of State business entity data (access review; no bulk file found) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/mo-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Missouri Secretary of State, Business Services Division (Corporations)
sources.gate: No bulk entity file was found: data.mo.gov (Socrata) has no business-entity dataset (its Secretary of State datasets are the office's payroll and accounting), and the Secretary's pages describe only the free interactive search (bsd.sos.mo.gov) and a $5 abstract of a single entity under RSMo 351.657. www.sos.mo.gov/robots.txt disallows /BusinessEntity/ (the search application) for all agents. A person should ask the Business Services Division whether an entity extract exists and at what price, or file a Missouri Sunshine Law request (RSMo ch. 610; see public-information-requests.md). Do not scrape the search.
sources.notes: data.mo.gov catalog search (Socrata catalog API, robots Crawl-delay 1) for 'business entities' and 'secretary of state' returned no entity register. bsd.sos.mo.gov has no robots.txt (404). The UCC bulk-records rule (15 CSR 30-90) provides bulk UCC data under a written agreement; that is not the corporate register. Nothing was purchased or requested.
